items.title: Iraquara (BA) Services procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 26 #CR 012-2025
items.en_title: Iraquara (BA) Services procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 26 #CR 012-2025
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Iraquara (BA) is procuring professional or outsourced services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 1,643,500; proposals close Nov 26 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
